model.name: log-linear growth with 48h harmonic oscillation and left-censored Tobit observation model
model.observation_model: Gaussian log10 errors with left-censoring below limit of detection (10 parasites/mL)

diagnostics.baseline_comparison: Harmonic model improves training log10 RMSE from 0.2237 to 0.0680, AIC from 5.89 to -10.30, and LOOCV RMSE from 0.2746 to 0.1259, capturing the 48-hour Plasmodium falciparum schizogony/sequestration cycle.
